ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.2 DoBill Worker Retirement
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.2.2 for RimWorld 1.5. Removes the D.2/D.2.1 live BillStack readiness worker experiment after runtime evidence showed a 70.1% worker-failure rate and 4.915ms average successful wait. DoBill retains its persistent membership index and package-local false readiness memo on the main thread. T34-D.1.3 large GenClosest worker validation plus Reachability and MapPawns shared-cache guards remain active.
